verdict.rationale: Linear's own agent produces AI-generated output from workspace data inside the product. 'Write with Agent' reviews recent changes and linked Slack messages to draft project updates, and loops can explain what changed when a project shifts. Customer feedback is automatically labeled and prioritized. This is mostly drafting and automation rather than a dedicated insights or suggestions surface. missing for 10: explicit AI analytics/insights over issue and project data (trends, risks, recommendations), documented proactive suggestions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: The agent reviews changes made since the last update, checks messages in the linked Slack channel, and writes an update draft for you to refine.
When a project's target date changes, a loop can automatically update the launch plan and post a Slack message explaining what changed, why, and who needs to act.
Automatically turn conversations and customer feedback into actionable issues that are instantly routed, labeled, and prioritized for the right team.
